value.title: Automatic resource-economy notice is once per application process
value.statement: When cache economy, serialized work or actual free-memory resource delay is applied, the visible resumed current map receives a readable resource notice. An atomic process-session claim prevents repeats across callbacks, layers, maps and Activity recreation; only a new process starts a new claim. Manual map-loading status remains independent of that claim and is available while the current guard reports economy. Retry re-evaluates resource/cache policy rather than rebuilding every GeoJSON source. UI and lifecycle callbacks must not change saved visibility, geometry or data. The isolated verification app preserves production automatic delivery in the dedicated memory suite; other gesture/layout suites acknowledge that one known notice only in verification.
